ns2:course.label: The Films of Ingmar Bergman
ns2:course.description: Focuses on Bergman's major films of the late 1950s and 1960s; involves reading screenplays and extensive criticism in addition to viewing the films; and includes important artistic influences on Bergman as well as his own significance as a major twentieth-century artist. Knowledge of Swedish not required. Same as CINE 490.
